scenicChapters.title: Romantische Strasse
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 12 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Romantic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 67 km this is Romantic Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

storyWas: Green hills, castle views and softer touring curves.
